headline: House resolution to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth was set aside when the House voted 211-204 to refer it to committee.
what_it_does: If adopted, this resolution would have impeached Peter Brian Hegseth, the Secretary of Defense, for "high crimes and misdemeanors." Impeachment by the House would have sent the case to the Senate for a trial, where a two-thirds vote is needed to remove an official from office. No official summary is available, so the specific charges are not described here. On November 10, 2026, the House voted to send it to committee instead of voting on it directly.

who_it_affects.group: Secretary of Defense Peter Brian Hegseth
who_it_affects.how: He would have been formally charged by the House and faced a Senate trial that could have removed him from office.
